'''Jilain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was present at the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] shortly before the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR" />
